messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: high generation latency detected in eu-west-1 (service: text-gen). Error pattern: elevated 5xx and 503s across scaled replicas. Incident ID inc-2026-04-eu-01. Playbooks: <https://redwood.run/playbooks/incidents/generation-latency|gen-latency-runbook>.
arn: ack — I'm oncall. investigating now. rolling to primary node to check recent deploys.
mira_sre: seeing spike starting at ~11:02 UTC. tailing logs:
```
2026-04-23T11:02:14Z gen[worker-7]: model init timeout (10s) -> 503
2026-04-23T11:02:19Z gen[worker-3]: OOM when serving long prompt -> 5xx
```
arn: quick mitigation: disabling model_autoscaler for gen-cluster-eu, switching routing to fallback model small-quant (lower perf but stable). Doing now: `infractl cluster update gen-cluster-eu --set model=small-quant --disable-autoscaler`
jo_comms: noted. Need brief customer-facing initial blurb. Suggested cadence: initial (T+10), update (T+30), resolution. Also need internal ticker for legal/CS.
ana_pm: impact: embeddings and chat completions in EU may see timeouts and higher latency; estimated affected customers: <~12 known heavy EU tenants> (based on recent traces).
ola_legal: keep wording generic (do not call out customers by name). avoid SLA language until we have root cause.
sam_cs: flagging top 5 EU customers in case they ask. I'll prep support tickets but will not send until we have an ETA.
mira_sre: mitigation applied: routing switched, small-quant up across replicas, autoscaler off. Early metrics: 95p latency dropped from ~2.4s to 600ms, error rate down ~78%. continuing monitoring.
arn: thanks. can we craft the initial status notice? jo_comms, propose: 
```
We are investigating elevated latency and errors for text generation in the eu-west region. Some requests may return errors or take longer than usual. Engineers are investigating and mitigation is in progress. We will post updates within 30 minutes.
```
jo_comms: good — tweak: add "no evidence of data exposure" per legal. New draft: 
```
We are investigating elevated latency and intermittent errors for text generation in the eu-west region. Some customers may observe slower responses or errors. Engineers are actively mitigating the issue; there is no evidence of data exposure. Next update in 30 minutes.
```
ola_legal: ok on that wording. keep "no evidence" until final confirm.
arn: can we include recommended temporary workarounds for customers? e.g., set "max_tokens" lower or route to global region?
jo_comms: add short note: "If you're affected, try smaller prompts or route to other regions; contact support for assisted routing."
sam_cs: I'll queue templated support messages and mark them as "hold" until we publish public notice.
mira_sre: running additional checks on model cache eviction — found elevated KV cache churn on node-3; attempted restart but held off to avoid disruption.
arn: decision: no full restart yet. keep routing fallback; prepare for canary restart of node-3 in 15m if metrics don't improve.
jo_comms: posting plan to status page in T+10. please confirm final copy by T+8.
arn: confirmed. final initial copy: 
```
Initial update (11:12 UTC): We are investigating elevated latency and intermittent errors affecting text generation in eu-west. Some requests may time out or be slower than normal. Engineers have implemented a routing fallback to a lower-capacity model to reduce error rates; mitigations are in progress. We will share another update within 30 minutes.
```
jo_comms: approved. publishing now. (publishing link queued) :rocket:
incident-bot: statuspage draft posted: <https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/inc-2026-04-eu-01|inc-2026-04-eu-01-draft> (visibility: public).
mira_sre: monitoring shows continued improvement; error rate stable but still ~3x baseline. planning targeted cache tuning on node-3 at T+20.
arn: if tuning fails, schedule controlled restart of node-3 at T+25 with canary first.
nana_pm: can we prepare customer-facing resolved copy in parallel? jo_comms, happy to draft with bullet points for RM.
jo_comms: drafting resolved copy now, will post for quick legal check. proposed resolved copy: 
```
Resolved: At 11:40 UTC we mitigated elevated latency and intermittent errors in eu-west text generation. Root cause: KV cache churn on a single replica leading to increased initialization time and OOMs under certain prompt shapes. Mitigation: routing to a fallback model, cache tuning, and a controlled restart of the affected replica. Impact: some customers experienced slower responses or transient errors between 11:02–11:38 UTC. No evidence of data exposure. If you see continued issues, contact support.
```
ola_legal: suggest removing specific minute ranges until confirmed by postmortem; keep broader window "~11:00–11:40 UTC". Also add contact/legal review tag.
jo_comms: updated resolved copy per legal. new draft: 
```
Resolved: We mitigated elevated latency and intermittent errors affecting text generation in eu-west. Root cause appears to be KV cache churn on a single replica causing initialization delays and OOMs for certain prompt sizes. Mitigations included routing to a fallback model, cache tuning, and a controlled restart of the affected replica. Impact window: ~11:00–11:40 UTC. Some customers experienced slower responses or transient errors during this time. No evidence of data exposure. If you continue to experience issues, please contact support.
```
sam_cs: approved for customer-facing support templates. I'll attach to the 1:1s with priority customers if needed.
mira_sre: performed canary restart of node-3 at 11:34 UTC; metrics returned to baseline.
arn: marking incident as resolved in infra tracker. can someone publish resolved notice? jo_comms: publishing resolved notice now. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: statuspage update published: <https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/inc-2026-04-eu-01/updates/3|Resolved update>. Incident status: resolved.
jo_comms: final note for postmortem: add action items — (1) improve KV cache eviction policy, (2) add canary restart automation, (3) add a short customer-facing runbook for recommended temporary workarounds.
arn: thanks team. I'll start the postmortem doc and ping for owners on the action items.
sam_cs: closing support hold; will notify flagged customers with the resolved copy.
jo_comms: closing thread — will attach all drafts to the incident doc. :wave:
